stock.note: the native binary of npm oxlint-tsgolint@7.0.2005, the release whose rule code tsrslint ports (bench/README.md)

projects.name: webpack
projects.install: npx --yes yarn@1.22.22 install --ignore-scripts --ignore-engines && npx --yes yarn@1.22.22 link --link-folder "$PWD/node_modules/.yarn-link" && npx --yes yarn@1.22.22 link --link-folder "$PWD/node_modules/.yarn-link" webpack

projects.name: cal-diy
projects.install: export YARN_NM_MODE=classic YARN_ENABLE_GLOBAL_CACHE=false YARN_CACHE_FOLDER="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tsrs-bench-yarn-cache" TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 && node .yarn/releases/yarn-4.12.0.cjs install --immutable --mode=skip-build && node .yarn/releases/yarn-4.12.0.cjs turbo run post-install @calcom/trpc#build --output-logs=errors-only

projects.name: formbricks-web
projects.install: mkdir -p .bench-bin && printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec npx --yes pnpm@11.7.0 "$@"\n' > .bench-bin/pnpm && chmod +x .bench-bin/pnpm && export PATH="$PWD/.bench-bin:$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH" DATABASE_URL=postgresql://bench@localhost:5432/bench TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && turbo run build --filter='@formbricks/web^...' --output-logs=errors-only

projects.name: supabase-studio
projects.install: npx --yes pnpm@11.13.1 install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --filter studio... && cd apps/studio && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next typegen
